resources.string: HyperOS tweaks. Lift Security Center\'s private AppOps restrictions.
Not active: enable All4Hyper in LSPosed and open it again.
Active (%1$s, API %2$d). Changes apply right away.
Connected to %1$s (API %2$d), but Security Center (com.miui.securitycenter) is not in the scope. Tick it in LSPosed.

Security Center can no longer restrict Xiaomi\'s private AppOps (install apps, chain launch, device identifiers, screen recording, accessibility, AI screen control). Restrictions set before you turn this on stay until you change them.
This also removes protections against accessibility and screen recording abuse. Only turn it on if you trust your installed apps.
